result.brief: 通过反事实干预可视化 PPO 价值函数中隐含的环境规则知识，属于智能体内部世界建模的实证分析，而非视频或多模态基础世界模型与表征学习贡献。
result.reason: Probes whether a PPO value function implicitly encodes environment dynamics in Crafter, but it is an interpretability study of RL agents, not a video/multimodal world model or representation learning contribution.
